description: PostgreSQL 18 line, lseg, box, path, polygon, and circle input, canonical output, storage, and error parity
sql: SELECT '{1,2,3}'::line AS coefficients, '[(1,2),(3,4)]'::line AS bracket_points, '1,2,3,4'::line AS bare_points;
SELECT '[(1,2),(3,4)]'::lseg AS bracketed, '((1,2),(3,4))'::lseg AS parenthesized, '1,2,3,4'::lseg AS bare;
SELECT '(1,2),(3,4)'::box AS points, '((1,2),(3,4))'::box AS parenthesized, '1,2,3,4'::box AS bare;
SELECT '[(1,2),(3,4)]'::path AS open_path, '((1,2),(3,4))'::path AS closed_path, '1,2,3,4'::path AS bare_closed_path;
SELECT '<(1,2),3>'::circle AS angled, '((1,2),3)'::circle AS parenthesized, '1,2,3'::circle AS bare;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_geometric_types (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, line_value line, segment_value lseg, box_value box, path_value path, polygon_value polygon, circle_value circle);
SELECT * FROM type_matrix_geometric_types ORDER BY id;
